raw_segments.text: Drawing in a long, lean breath, I, Parsi, I see thee again.
I am thou goest before, and this, this then is the hearse that thou didst promise.
But I hold thee to the last letter of thy word.
Repair them if ye can in time, and return to me.
If not, Ahab is enough to die, down men.
The first thing that but offers to jump from this boat I stand in, that thing I harpoon.
You're not other men but my arms and my legs, and so obey me.
Where's the whale? Gone down again.
